up: Retrieve the ChEMBL IDs and preferred names of all distinct molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL3881481'. Join the 'docs' table (filtered by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3881481') to 'compound_records' on doc_id, and then to 'molecule_dictionary' on molregno. Return distinct rows containing molecule chembl_id and pref_name.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3881481';
